lede: Adds invoice filtering but the new date-range validator allows an end date before the start date.

correctness: The date-range validator does not check that end >= start.
security: No new auth or data-access surface introduced.
accessibility: New filter inputs have labels but no aria-describedby for the validation error.
consistency: Follows the existing filter-panel pattern from the runbook feature.

findings.summary: Date-range filter accepts an end date before the start date.
findings.detail: validateDateRange only checks both fields are present, never their order.

findings.summary: Filter panel's clear button has no accessible label.

notVerifiedExtra: Whether the backend actually rejects an invalid date range server-side was not checked. This PR only covers the client-side filter UI.
